package.name: living_map
package.description: The Living Map - multi-robot spatial memory for GPS-denied emergency zones (frontier/DFS Writers with a utility function, fast-writer drones, Wi-Fi CSI + camera victim detection with fusion, three Outside Network Area stations + mission server) (TSYP14 IEEE RAS x AESS). Phase 1 simulation: Gazebo Fortress + ROS 2 Humble.
